Distance = Speed x time

26985.question_text: A circuit has a resistance of 200Ω. The resistance of the circuit can be reduced to 120Ω when

\(\frac{1}{R_t}\) = \(\frac{1}{R_1}\) + \(\frac{1}{R_2}\) = \(\frac{1}{200}\) + \(\frac{1}{300}\)

R\(_t\)  = \(\frac{200 \times 300}{200 + 300}\) = \(\frac{6000}{500}\) = 120 \(\Omega\)
